message.content: The initial suite passes. One edge-case review found that typing-run boundaries should be explicit (for example, moving away and back must not accidentally merge two runs), and contiguous multi-caret typing should undo as a single coordinated run. I’m tightening that history behavior before finalizing.

function.name: execute_bash

content:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='/app/public/editor.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("      this.version = 0;\n      this._lines();", "      this.version = 0;\n      this.typingRun = 0;\n      this._lines();")
s=s.replace("    sameCarets(a, b) { return a.length === b.length && a.every((c, i) => c.anchor === b[i].anchor && c.head === b[i].head); }\n\n    commit", "    sameCarets(a, b) { return a.length === b.length && a.every((c, i) => c.anchor === b[i].anchor && c.head === b[i].head); }\n    breakTyping() { this.typingRun += 1; }\n\n    commit")
s=s.replace("      const canMerge = merge && this.carets.length === 1 && previous?.type === type &&\n        Date.now() - previous.time < 1200 && this.sameCarets(previous.after.carets, before.carets);", "      if (type !== 'typing') this.breakTyping();\n      const canMerge = merge && previous?.type === type && previous.typingRun === this.typingRun &&\n        Date.now() - previous.time < 1200 && this.sameCarets(previous.after.carets, before.carets);")
s=s.replace("        this.undoStack.push({ before, after, type, time: Date.now() });", "        this.undoStack.push({ before, after, type, typingRun: this.typingRun, time: Date.now() });")
s=s.replace("    move(kind, extend = false, byWord = false) {\n      this.carets", "    move(kind, extend = false, byWord = false) {\n      this.breakTyping();\n      this.carets")
s=s.replace("    selectAll() { this.carets", "    selectAll() { this.breakTyping(); this.carets")
s=s.replace("        this.dragging = true; this.dragAnchor", "        this.model.breakTyping();\n        this.dragging = true; this.dragAnchor")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
p='/app/test/editor.test.js'
s=open(p).read()
needle="test('typing over a selection is one independent edit', () => {"
insert="""test('cursor movement separates typing runs even when it returns to the same offset', () => {
  const model = new EditorModel('');
  model.insert('a'); model.move('left'); model.move('right'); model.insert('b');
  assert.equal(model.undoStack.length, 2); model.undo(); assert.equal(model.text, 'a');
});
test('a contiguous multi-caret typing run undoes together', () => {
  const model = new EditorModel('a\\nb');
  model.carets = [{ anchor: 1, head: 1 }, { anchor: 3, head: 3 }];
  model.insert('x'); model.insert('y'); assert.equal(model.text, 'axy\\nbxy');
  assert.equal(model.undoStack.length, 1); model.undo(); assert.equal(model.text, 'a\\nb');
});
"""
s=s.replace(needle, insert+needle)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
